agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68 labelled FF58 PET imaging agent (68Ga)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: integrin alpha-v beta-3 / alpha-v beta-5 expression (68Ga-FF58 PET uptake)

source_quote.quote: a radioligand therapy for patients with advanced or metastatic tumors that express proteins known as integrins: alpha-v beta-3 integrin (αvβ3) and alpha-v beta-5 integrin (αvβ5)

flag.reason: Selection is by imaging uptake of the paired tracer (target expression); imaging-only markers are not molecular biomarkers under manual section 5, but the tracer reports the radioligand's own target.

coder_notes: Basket (PDAC, gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma, recurrent GBM). Eligibility requires 68Ga-FF58 uptake on PET, i.e. imaging-defined integrin target expression linked to the 177Lu radioligand. PK is blood radioactivity, but tumour-lesion time-activity curves are planned, coded tumour_pk_planned yes.
